note: Quick, Draw! cannon 5140965633294336, drawn in side view with the muzzle at the upper right. Stroke 0 is the muzzle ring seen end-on. Stroke 1 is the top line of the barrel, running from the muzzle down to the breech end of the trail at the left. Stroke 2 is the under line of the barrel and trail, from below the muzzle down to the trail foot at the left and up to the breech. Stroke 3 is the wheel. Strokes 4 to 7 are the four spokes. In the film the model cannon stands on a turntable and turns a full circle, so the rig does not bend: the whole drawing is placed by a point at the height of the wheel hub on the drawing's centre line (the mean x of its vertices, so the drawing does not jump sideways when it flips facing) and a point a fixed height above it, which keeps one size and no tilt, and the turn is a flipbook turn: the drawing narrows toward its centre line as the cannon comes end-on to the camera, flips its facing there, and widens again to the other profile.
